src.title: SVG file
opt.max_colors_hint: How many filaments your printer can use. 0 = no limit.
opt.merge_hint: 0 = off. Higher values join colors that look alike (ΔE).
base.hint: 0 mm = no base. With a base, the colors sit on top of it (new 3MF only).
adv.hint: A smaller precision keeps more detail and makes bigger files.
adv.min_detail_hint: Lines thinner than the nozzle cannot be printed; they are handed to the neighboring color. 0 = off; about half the nozzle diameter works well.
col.name: Part name
col.background_hint: This color spans the whole drawing. Untick it if it is only a background.
col.beyond_filaments: some filament numbers are above the {n} loaded in OrcaSlicer
prev.empty: Choose an SVG to see how it will be split.
target.title: Apply to
target.new: A new object on the plate
out.stl: Also save one STL per color
apply.dirty: The open project has unsaved changes. Save it (Ctrl+S) before applying.
plate.hint: OrcaSlicer's plugin API cannot change the plate directly: the design goes into the saved project, which reopens here with the new parts. Save the project (Ctrl+S) first.
plate.no_match: {name} is not in the saved project yet. Save it (Ctrl+S) and read the plate again.
face.label: {dir} · {w} × {h} mm
objects.label: {name} · {size} · {parts} part(s)
status.plate_unsaved: None of the objects on the plate comes from a saved .3mf. Save the project first (Ctrl+S).
status.matched: Filaments matched to the closest colors.
progress.details: Handing thin details to their neighbors…
warn.gradient: Gradients were replaced by the average of their colors.
warn.unknown_paint: Some paints (patterns or missing references) were ignored.
warn.transparency: Semi-transparent shapes are treated as opaque.
warn.text: The SVG has text that is not converted to paths. Convert text to outlines in your editor.
warn.clip_mask: Clipping paths and masks are ignored. Release them in your editor if shapes show up where they should not.
warn.dashes: Dashed outlines are printed as solid lines.
warn.empty_part: {name} ended up empty and was skipped.
warn.exceeds_face: The design is larger than the chosen surface ({w} × {h} mm); what falls outside is cut off.
warn.too_thick: The thickness is larger than the object's depth under this surface.
warn.not_watertight: Not watertight (the slicer will usually repair it): {names}
warn.project_filaments: The project has only {n} filament(s); OrcaSlicer will print these parts with filament 1: {names}. Add filaments to the project or choose others.
error.no_object: Choose an object of the project.
error.no_regions: No filled area left after processing the SVG.
error.stale_colors: The colors changed since the analysis. Analyze again.
error.same_output: The output must be a different file from the project.
error.svg_no_shapes: No filled shape was found in the SVG.
error.svg_no_area: The SVG shapes have no area.
error.project_missing_part: The project references a missing file: {name}
error.project_no_object: Object {id} was not found in the project.
error.no_faces: No flat surface was found on this object.
error.nothing_on_face: Nothing of the design falls on this surface. Choose another surface or a different width.
error.picker: The file dialog is not available ({detail}). Use the upload button instead.
error.too_big: The file is too large (64 MB max).
error.busy: Another operation is running. Wait for it to finish.
error.no_window: This OrcaSlicer build cannot open plugin windows. Use the SVG Multicolor page instead.
error.denied_name: OrcaSlicer does not let plugins use a file or folder whose name contains “conf”, “cert” or “secret”: {path}. Rename it or move the file to another folder.
error.permission: OrcaSlicer blocked the plugin from reaching a file ({detail}). If you declined a permission prompt, allow it next time, or use a file in another folder.
error.deps_blocked: OrcaSlicer does not let the plugin load its libraries (numpy, shapely) at this point. Restart OrcaSlicer: the plugin loads them when OrcaSlicer starts.
